messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from the all-hands runtime Q&A. Need two things for the upcoming kernel work: 1) a short list of perf knobs we should try for sub-120ms p50 on chat bursts, and 2) what to expect from the kernel v2 timeline + canary gating.

samir: High level: v2 canary next week for a tiny dedicated pool, broader canary in ~3 weeks, GA in ~9 weeks if stable. Canary gates: latency, error rate, and memory regressions. We'll post the exact gates tomorrow.

leo: Perf knobs to try: microbatch_window_ms=3-6, max_batch_size=4-8 for chat bursts, enable prefix cache for repeated prompts, kv_prewarm optional (mem tradeoff). Also try per-request latency caps to avoid H-O-L blocking.

anya: Can you quantify the memory bump for kv_prewarm? Ops will ask.

leo: Roughly +5-12% resident mem on typical LLMs; depends on seq len and number of hot prefixes. If constrained, use kv_adaptive=true so cache warms gradually.

diana: Ops/gating suggestion: abort canary if p50 > 150ms for 5m OR p95 > 450ms for 3m OR OOMs > 0 for 10m. Also track KV hit ratio and avg microbatch delay. Tag traces with canary=kernel-v2 and batch_profile.

harry: For Dedicated, we recommend pinning canary to identical GPU nodes and disabling autoscale for the window. Also enable 100% tracing for canary traffic.

samir: Note: v2 includes plumbing for quantized kernels (int8) but int8 will be experimental opt-in at first. Multi-model routing (fallback to smaller model) is on roadmap; prototype planned in the next quarter.

anya: Good. Any suggested minimal canary config we can paste into the job?

leo: Minimal example: 
"runtime: kernel=v2; pool=canary-small; batching: enabled, microbatch_window_ms=4, max_batch_size=6; cache: kv_prewarm=false, kv_adaptive=true; monitoring: trace_tags=[canary:kernel-v2,batch_profile], sample_rate=100%"

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job #6123 -> canary-small (kernel-v2). ETA 05:20 UTC.

anya: Thanks everyone 97 I'll assemble the checklist and drop it into the canary channel. If you have short sim scripts for tuning, please attach them here.
